newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLAIPEDA PORT 7-MO CARGO HANDLING GAINS.
newsitem.headline: KLAIPEDA PORT 7-MO CARGO HANDLING GAINS.

text.p: Lithuania's Klaipeda port said on Monday that it handled 9.26 million tonnes of cargo in the first seven months of the year compared to 7.67 million tonnes in the same period in 1996.
"The companies of Klaipeda port handled 20.73 percent more cargo in the first seven month of the year than the same period last year," Vilius Kaunietis, the head of marketing, told Reuters.
The port handled more metal, timber and grain cargo in the seven months of the year, Kaunietis said.
Kaunietis also said that the port served 3,391 ships in the first seven months of the year compared to 3,197 ships in the same period in 1996.
The companies in the port handled 21,200 TEUs in the first seven months of the year compared to 24,000 in the same period in 1996, Kaunietis said.
The port's companies handled 1.53 million tonnes in July 1997 compared to 1.16 million tonnes in the same period last year, Kaunietis added.
